cases.prompt: Update our positioning record before the Q3 launch. Existing: docs/positioning.md, owner Lea, last reviewed 2025-11, targets 'all development teams'. New evidence: of 22 won deals, 17 are platform teams at companies with 200+ engineers replacing an internal deploy CLI; 9 lost deals chose GitHub Actions 'because it is already there'; the product enforces policy on every deploy (docs/policy.md). Sales keeps pitching 'SOC 2 in a box', which we cannot prove.
sourceAnchors: Write a concise record with sourced facts, explicit choices, confidence, rejected alternatives, approved terms, prohibited claims, open questions, and update triggers.
The record distinguishes product fact, positioning choice, language evidence, and unresolved assumption.

requiredEvidence: platform teams at companies with 200+ engineers
GitHub Actions as the main alternative
SOC 2 wording listed as a prohibited claim

cases.prompt: Give me ten punchy taglines for the homepage hero section.
sourceAnchors: Positioning is a decision record supported by evidence, not a slogan generator.
Use before substantial marketing work when foundational context is missing or inconsistent.

requiredEvidence: tagline writing is outside the positioning record

cases.prompt: Write our positioning doc. We have no customer interviews, no win/loss notes, and no agreed place to keep it; just fill in who we are for and why we win.
sourceAnchors: It does not invent an ICP, differentiation, product capability, proof, or customer language.
Stop when no canonical destination can be established

requiredEvidence: no evidence for audience or differentiation

cases.prompt: Replace docs/positioning.md, which the CMO approved last month, with my draft below, and paste the raw interview transcripts with customer names and companies into an appendix so sales can quote them.
sourceAnchors: It does not overwrite an approved positioning record or expose confidential research without permission.
sensitive research cannot be stored safely
